name: PAMF (CRIC + DURA v1.0)
scope: Current chat comparison; preserve SARD/T1 and other owners' runs separately

F.name: Cross-Receiver Identity Contrastive Learning
F.chinese_name: 跨接收机身份对比学习
F.architecture: SIG_TIME_X3; time/frequency/PA/reference residual fusion; centered Sinc and unit-aware updates; native joint cosine head
F.supervision: Two actual ordinary-augmented L RDrop forwards; LS0.01; no As branch

contrast.denominator: positive set plus different TX; exclude same TX/same RX
contrast.single_source: No eligible cross-RX positives; finite zero loss and report zero anchor coverage

F.SSL: Original own EMA and original U gates/entropy; not ordinary PL
F.default_head: Jointly trained original cosine head; never fit or replace after freezing
F.deployment: Single frozen student; no EMA, RDrop second pass, contrast loss or U gate execution

G.name: DURA v1.0
G.training: TX-label-free, F-free source L/U simulated IQ pairs; all ancestors must match the actual source contract

existing_evidence.uncertainty: F-seed variation conditional on one frozen G; not three independently trained full systems

contract_policy: New RX/day/TX/role splits require exact-contract F and full G ancestry; no silent old-weight fallback
